flags.summary: On Aug. 29, 2022, District 2 opponent Ryan Topping challenged her candidacy, arguing she had improperly completed her statement of economic interests (CAN-12) by writing 'N/A' for her employer; the Floyd County Election Board set a Sept. 6, 2022 hearing. Wiseheart said 'I have nothing to hide' and that she has no economic interests with NAFCS. She appeared on the ballot and was re-elected in November 2022.
flags.note: A 2022 ballot-access challenge, not a misconduct finding. The election board's ruling was not read directly; inferred from her later re-election.
